mission: 核目标1/2/6/7原验收与现成果是否仍有具体必要消费者/入口/目录错误或方法缺口；优先theory剩余13来源、外部方法的保存结果三条件、sharedCLI原8指纹失败的真实依赖，查新发表成果是否已经解决，不能全库重验/重新训练/装平台/改冻结失败。允许最多两个有明确用途及可执行输入的具体修复/分析；列原owner/精确路径/许可和不重复理由。核外部目标四标准是否只是已有成果未整理提交，而不是实验待跑。
task_scope: bounded evidence and remaining-work audit only
expected_outputs: one concise JSON with goal criterion/evidence/remaining necessary action/whether executable/owner/exact input/budget/protected boundary
actual source paths and commits, no generic whole-library work
stop_conditions: no change to existing frozen contracts or results
no new statistic/model/policy path or external source request
ambiguous core semantics reported for root, independent audit continues
user_authority: 2026-10-11 direct user: continue remaining eight goals; parallelize independent subagents for efficiency.
referenced_evidence_read_policy: Only the directly referenced existing reports/manifests/contracts may be read. No writes outside exact output; do not scan whole library.
